paragraphs: A modern match ball is not a stitched sphere any more. The panels are thermally bonded and shaped in long curved forms rather than hexagons, with moulded grooves across the surface that change how air flows over it. Those grooves are the detail that dates a ball to a season, and they have to be geometry rather than a bump map to read correctly.
The mesh is 24,624 polygons and 12,520 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, built to StemCell specification so it works in a real-time engine as well as an offline render.
A second build sits on this page at $49. Both suit football broadcast graphics, sports advertising, retail and catalogue renders, stadium and pitch scenes, and games. On sale since 2023.
